objective: Test whether a compact two-slot parent-response queue can preserve M474 exact signed dual-update semantics while removing the same-cycle issue-parent consume dependency from prefetch_ready. This is a micro-functional Synopsys VCS/SVA gate only.

motivation_from_m475.finding: M475 met the frozen 3.0 ns pre-macro DC gate with setup WNS 0.0000 ns, 70 logic levels and all 100 reported setup paths within 0.0044 ns. The worst startpoint was issue_parent_id[4].
motivation_from_m475.architectural_change: Reserve two compacted parent-response slots and never credit a same-cycle parent consume to prefetch_ready. One synchronous read may be in flight. A returning read and a same-cycle RAW-forwarded final write may enqueue together.
motivation_from_m475.production_instrumentation_change: Remove cumulative 32-bit debug counters from the production module. VCS/SVA/TB count public event pulses externally. This is a new RTL identity and receives new VCS/DC/Formality gates.

memory_geometry.external_parent_scratch: 64 words x 96 lanes x signed12 = 64 x 1152 bits = 9 KiB, synchronous 1R1W, excluded
memory_geometry.two_response_slots_inside_rtl: 2 x 96 lanes x signed12 = 288 B total
memory_geometry.external_resident_psum_if_64_rows: 64 x 96 lanes x signed19 = 14.25 KiB, excluded

required_directed_coverage: synchronous macro read and registered-Q response
same-cycle macro response plus RAW-forwarded write dual enqueue
queue occupancy two and no same-cycle consume credit to prefetch_ready
held prefetch stability while full and acceptance after consume
head compaction and back-to-back parent completions
